items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: Well that's who he worked with. I never knew him.

ctx.x: Raleigh. Oh let's see. Amos Raleigh. He worked with Amos a long time. You remember Amos Raleigh? Yeah. I didn't know him but his son is still playing.

Yeah. Yeah. Well that's who he worked with. I never knew him. Well he was a pretty good trumpet player at that time. You know what I mean? Yeah. And George Washington worked with him. Yeah. George used to work with him.
Do you know when he died or what happened to him?
